method.distance: Sum horizontal haversine distances between consecutive GPX trkpt coordinates; Earth radius6371000m
method.elevationGain: sum(max(0,ele[i]-ele[i-1])); no smoothing; preserve repeated points
method.duration: 90+110minutes, published average up/down values in the official route card
method.rounding: distance to two decimals in kilometres; elevation to integer metres

coordinateControl.comparisonNote: The selected loop visits Sokolica/Pieninki east of the Szopka approach. The westernmost point lies north-east of Szopka; no detour to Trzy Korony is included. This geographic comparison does not certify future route availability.

closedSectionComparison.selection: GPX point nearest official Szopka coordinate through highest GPX point on Trzy Korony loop
closedSectionComparison.method: Minimum equirectangular point-to-segment distance at reference latitude49.42N. Geographic separation check, not live trail-access approval.

limitations: Derived metrics describe this exact published track, not a ground survey. Unsmoothed cumulative ascent depends on GPX sampling and altitude data.
The full GPX is not redistributed here: its publication does not by itself establish a reuse license. Reproduce from the operator URL and verify SHA-256 before comparing.
The 200-minute sum excludes breaks, queues and weather delays; no universal fitness or seasonal-access claim.
